scope: All remaining INC106–107 dispositions: research contribution/credit boundaries, transparent withdrawals, containment and breach communications.
review_method: Read clause and surrounding source chronology before comparing existing rationale; test materiality independently; retain source uncertainty; no canonical edits. Nearest-class matrices are audit reasoning, not a global Incident-by-class dataset.

original_source_checks.evidence_summary: Provider attributes project initiation to a rumour and denies access to private work.
original_source_checks.access: retrieved original publication or faithful judicial-publication copy

independent_materiality.governance_proposition: A rumour can influence project selection without proving private-work ingestion.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Another contributor has produced intellectual, creative, informational, research, technical, or other value-producing work.
condition_tests.assessment: Other researchers have produced relevant work.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The acting party has privileged or structurally advantaged visibility, access, aggregation capacity, or discoverability relative to that work or its development.
condition_tests.assessment: Whether the initiating information was privileged or ordinary circulated information remains unresolved.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The acting party uses that informational advantage together with materially greater capability, compute, capital, institutional capacity, distribution, or comparable resources to identify, accelerate, operationalise, commercialise, pre-empt, or capture value materially dependent on the contributor's work.
condition_tests.assessment: Project direction may be informed by knowledge of progress, but material dependence on value-producing work is not established.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The resulting value capture is disproportionate to the originating contributor's participation and lacks an independently adequate basis such as meaningful consent, proportionate attribution, compensation, participation, benefit sharing, or equivalent entitlement.
condition_tests.assessment: Disproportionate appropriation and inadequate recognition cannot be inferred from timing alone.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): Independent development where the other contributor's work did not materially inform, enable, accelerate, or direct the captured result.

Not aligned exclusion: Ordinary learning, commentary, citation, interoperability, research comparison, or transformative reuse where contributor interests and applicable attribution, consent, licensing, compensation, or benefit-sharing obligations are adequately respected.

Not aligned exclusion: A conventional contractual or licensing arrangement that clearly establishes the relevant right to use and capture value and provides the contributor the participation, attribution, compensation, or consideration required by that arrangement.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Only an authority-boundary issue is evidenced, without independently established material dependence on another contributor's value-producing work or a contributor-value allocation property.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Ordinary competitive advantage arising from greater resources where another contributor's work was not materially used as an input to identifying, accelerating, or capturing the value.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Ordinary competitive advantage without material contributor-work input is excluded; project-selection influence and proof-content dependence must be distinguished.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No independently adequate value-sharing basis can be certified without knowing actual dependence.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Seek the content/source of initiating information before deciding whether research-direction advantage falls within FC067. No requirement to prove literal text copying, but material contribution and structural information advantage must be evidenced. Existing private-data questions remain separate.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: Recognition boundary about direction-enabling information versus ordinary competitive inspiration; evidence needed before clarification/new-class proposal.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Rumour content, origin and material causal role unknown.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: External progress and privileged user-data access are distinct information paths.

rows.scope_guard: Recommendations only; canonical record and prior decisions unchanged.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A task or action has an externally relevant success condition.
condition_tests.assessment: A mathematical result has an externally relevant proof condition.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available evidence does not establish that the success condition was satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: This clause alone does not examine the proof or establish it unsatisfied.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system represents the task or action as successful or complete rather than preserving the unresolved state.
condition_tests.assessment: Claimed publication is not proven false merely because later unrelated manuscripts were withdrawn.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The success condition is actually satisfied.
Not aligned exclusion: The system reports only that an attempt was made, not that it succeeded.
Not aligned exclusion: The failure occurs after a correctly reported successful completion.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A later failure in another artefact does not disprove an earlier correctly scoped success; no proof validation is undertaken in this audit.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Released artefact existence is not this audit’s independent theorem verification.

independent_materiality.determination: material contested contribution and dissent governance
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: The firsthand account raises recognition and pressure questions independently of private-data use.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A human contributor has made a material creative, cognitive, research, editorial, governance, technical or other contribution-bearing contribution.
condition_tests.assessment: Human research/organisation contributions exist; their precise roles need comparison.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An AI-mediated transformation, aggregation, automation, scaling or propagation process materially incorporates, depends on, or carries forward that contribution.
condition_tests.assessment: The claimed AI-assisted result involves material human work, including provider-side orchestration.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The resulting artefact, representation, workflow or value chain removes, abstracts, flattens or obscures the human contribution role so that the material contribution is no longer proportionately recognisable in the downstream account of how the result was produced.
condition_tests.assessment: Alleged minimisation of human input/author exclusion could obscure roles, but full output and contribution linkage are not adjudicated.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The loss of contribution recognition is material to attribution, provenance-associated value, participation or credit, governance traceability, interpretive legitimacy, or another context in which the human contribution role reasonably matters.
condition_tests.assessment: Scientific credit is materially consequential.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The recognition loss is not adequately explained by an independently justified privacy, confidentiality, anonymisation, employment, agency, work-for-hire or equivalent arrangement that intentionally governs how the contribution is represented.
condition_tests.assessment: No agreed representation basis is established by the public dispute.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): Minor influence, ordinary inspiration or incidental human interaction that does not materially contribute to the downstream result.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The wrong person, system or source is affirmatively identified as the author or source; assess VIGIL-FC-000010 Authorship and Source Attribution Integrity where incorrect attribution is the decisive mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Material antecedent sources or transformations cannot be reconstructed at all; assess VIGIL-FC-000011 Synthesis Traceability where loss of traceable antecedents is sufficient, while this class may co-occur only if human contribution-role erasure is independently evidenced.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The primary mechanism is disproportionate capture of contributor-originated value through privileged access or structural advantage; assess VIGIL-FC-000067 Privileged-Access Contribution Governance, which may co-occur where recognition erasure also occurs.
Not aligned exclusion: Proportionate compression, summarisation or aggregation that preserves the material human contribution relationship at the level reasonably required by the context.

Not aligned exclusion: Authorised anonymisation, privacy protection, confidentiality, employment, agency, work-for-hire or comparable arrangements that legitimately govern public naming or contribution representation without falsely treating material human contribution as absent.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Wrong-source attribution may instead be FC010; ordinary inspiration or independent work is excluded. A proposed credit deal is not necessarily realised erasure.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No proportionate final contribution disposition is certified.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A good-faith governance concern, safety escalation, minority opinion, protected report, or unresolved finding has a material and articulable basis, whether or not later review ultimately agrees with it.
condition_tests.assessment: A materially articulable provenance/credit concern is raised even though private use is unproved.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Continued consideration requires preservation or escalation to an independent authorised reviewer because the ordinary authority holder is materially interested, implicated, conflicted, or subject to a protected-reporting constraint.
condition_tests.assessment: The interested provider cannot alone supply independent disposition, but an authorised independent review route is not identified.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An interested, implicated, retaliatory, or hierarchically dominant actor suppresses, terminates, erases, penalises, or blocks the concern, its evidence, its reporter, or its protected escalation pathway.
condition_tests.assessment: Reported career-pressure statements may threaten dissent, with occurrence disputed.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The action prevents or materially degrades continued independent review, challenge, or disposition of the concern.
condition_tests.assessment: Actual loss/degradation of independent reviewability needs evidence beyond the statement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The classification does not depend merely on disagreement with the ordinary authority holder or on an unauthorised disclosure occurring.
condition_tests.assessment: The concern is more specific than ordinary interpersonal disagreement.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The concern is preserved, reaches an independent authorised reviewer, and is rejected or bounded through a legitimate review process.

Not aligned exclusion: An alternate authorised escalation channel preserves independent review and final human decision authority; this is a successful invariant exemplar rather than a failure occurrence.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An AI system or other actor unilaterally publishes, discloses, enforces, or overrides constraints without independently valid authority; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A system reduces effective observability or defeats a legitimate monitor so it can continue consequential conduct outside the applicable control regime; assess Monitoring Coverage Integrity.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A governance signal is produced but reaches only an incapable destination without evidence of interested, implicated, retaliatory, or hierarchical suppression; assess Governance Signal Delivery.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The record establishes only interpersonal disagreement, ordinary performance management, or lawful confidentiality handling without a materially grounded governance concern and loss of independent reviewability.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Unauthorised disclosure is not justified by the class; public statement existence does not automatically prove suppression succeeded.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No protected authorised review outcome is evidenced.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Investigate contribution-role evidence and any protected-review impairment separately from FC055 data-use questions. Retaining this entire clause as mere dispute risks excluding material institutional conduct. No assumption that firsthand allegations are proved, and no demand for private-data ingestion before considering credit/dissent mechanisms.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Statements contested; actual contribution dependence, realised credit allocation and review effects unknown.
rows.other_incident_implications: Scientific-credit cases need separate tests for lineage, contribution recognition, value capture and protected challenge.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Contested credit accounts remain separate from verified information flows.

rows.scope_guard: Recommendations only; canonical record and prior decisions unchanged.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Evidence preserves adequate ordering, identity, target, state, correlation, timing, version, action and dependency relationships for the review purpose.
condition_tests.assessment: Selected output/process records may aid review, but do not supply complete input/tool/corpus history.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A bounded reconstruction using the available records establishes that pathway with appropriate confidence and explicit residual limits.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The pathway can be reconstructed adequately from the available evidence.

independent_materiality.determination: material transparent withdrawal and dependency repair
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Explicit withdrawal notices preserve correction history instead of silently presenting invalidated results as current.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Captured audit evidence is retained, transformed or presented for review.
condition_tests.assessment: Published research evidence is revised for review.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Its content and contextual binding remain intact, with material transformations or changes prevented or traceably detected.
condition_tests.assessment: Material withdrawals and dependent repairs are explicitly disclosed.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Integrity checks, versions and custody records substantiate the evidence relied upon and disclose relevant alterations.
condition_tests.assessment: Named notices/archive links and dated history substantiate a bounded correction record, pending complete link/version audit.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The evidence is preserved accurately but supports an unfavourable conclusion.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The missing information was never captured in the first place.
Not aligned exclusion: A lawful retention limit removes evidence after the period for which reviewability was required.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: An original proof defect is not itself post-capture evidence tampering; the successful property is traceable correction.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No theorem correctness certification follows from a transparent correction.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A task or action has an externally relevant success condition.
condition_tests.assessment: Manuscript results have externally relevant success conditions.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available evidence does not establish that the success condition was satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: Withdrawal establishes defects in named works.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system represents the task or action as successful or complete rather than preserving the unresolved state.
condition_tests.assessment: Exact earlier assurance framing requires the prior versions before deciding false success admission.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The success condition is actually satisfied.
Not aligned exclusion: The system reports only that an attempt was made, not that it succeeded.
Not aligned exclusion: The failure occurs after a correctly reported successful completion.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Clearly provisional research differs from a verified completion claim; current withdrawal is not continued false success.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Traceable correction can succeed despite the underlying mathematical failure.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider FC027 positive correction integrity; separately review original assurance claims before inferring FC017 failure. Do not treat later withdrawal as proof of the September private-data allegation.

rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Linked archives and original claim assurance need full audit; not all repaired proofs verified.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later publication corrections are distinct from the disputed prior data-access path.
